projects.title: Lighting for Bravecat
projects.description: Lighting for 'Bravecat' at the Oscar-winning studio PunkRobot. Focused on shot lighting, look dev, and complex render problem-solving across stylized environments to ensure artistic consistency and production efficiency.

projects.title: Tormented Souls 2 Tech Art & Lighting
projects.description: Integrated Lighting and Technical Art. Developed advanced shaders and Post-Process effects to push visual fidelity in a performance-constrained horror environment. Mastered UE5 Lumen balancing for dark scenes.

projects.title: UE5 Kitchen Relight
projects.description: High-fidelity interior relight of the 'Edith Finch' kitchen. Specialized in Unreal Engine 5 Lumen system, focusing on bounce lighting, atmospheric mood, and precise exposure control while maintaining 60fps performance targets.

projects.title: Fortnite Creative
projects.description: VFX and Shader development for high-reach Fortnite Creative ecosystems. Focused on Niagara particle systems and performant material logic for cross-platform play.

projects.title: Fallout Shelter
projects.description: Production and Live Ops support for Bethesda's mobile hit. Gained deep insights into mobile pipeline optimization requirements for global scale.
